title: Water Supply Error
shortDescription: The washer did not fill with water within the expected time.
fullDescription: The C1 error code on Hitachi washers indicates the machine did not detect sufficient water within approximately 10 minutes. Closed supply valves, clogged inlet screens, or a faulty inlet valve are typical causes.
symptoms: Only hot or cold water fills

fixSteps.title: Check supply valves
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure both hot and cold valves are fully open.

fixSteps.title: Clean inlet screens
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect hoses and clean mesh filter screens.

fixSteps.title: Check hoses for kinks
fixSteps.instruction: Straighten any bends in supply hoses.

videoSearchQuery: Hitachi washer C1 error water fill fix

faq.a: Unplug for 1 minute. Error clears if issue resolved.

faq.q: Are Hitachi parts available outside Japan?
faq.a: Yes, through authorized Hitachi service centers and online parts retailers.

title: Drain Error
shortDescription: The washer cannot drain water within the allowed time.
fullDescription: The C2 error code indicates the washer failed to drain within approximately 8 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Clean drain filter
fixSteps.instruction: Open filter panel. Drain water into pan. Clean filter.

videoSearchQuery: Hitachi washer C2 error drain fix

faq.a: Use the drain filter at the bottom.

title: Door Lock Error
shortDescription: The door lock failed to engage.
fullDescription: The C3 error code indicates the door lock assembly cannot secure the door.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi washer C3 error door lock fix

faq.a: It is one of the more frequently reported Hitachi washer errors.

title: Overflow Error
fullDescription: The C4 error code indicates water level has risen above the safe threshold.

fixSteps.title: Test pressure switch
fixSteps.instruction: Blow into port, listen for click.

fixSteps.title: Check inlet valve
fixSteps.instruction: Check if water flows when unplugged.

whenToCallPro: If inlet valve is stuck open.

faq.q: Can a clogged hose cause C4?

faq.a: Check if water flows through unplugged valve.

title: Motor Error
shortDescription: The drive motor is not functioning properly.
fullDescription: The C5 error code indicates the motor cannot start, stalls, or runs at wrong speeds.
whenToCallPro: If motor or inverter needs replacement.

title: Heating Error
shortDescription: The water heater has not reached target temperature.
fullDescription: The C6 error code indicates the heater element failed to heat water to the set temperature.

fixSteps.title: Test heater
fixSteps.instruction: Test resistance (20-40 ohms). Check for ground fault.

whenToCallPro: If not comfortable with electrical work.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Main control and display boards cannot communicate.
fullDescription: The C7 error code indicates a communication failure between the main and display boards.

title: Unbalanced Load Error
shortDescription: The washer detected an unbalanced load during spin.
fullDescription: The C8 error code indicates excessive vibration from an unbalanced load during spin.

fixSteps.title: Check shipping bolts
fixSteps.instruction: Verify all removed on new install.

whenToCallPro: If suspension is worn or bearing damaged.

title: Overflow Protection Triggered
shortDescription: The base flood sensor detected water.
fullDescription: The C9 error code is triggered when the base flood sensor detects water, indicating an internal leak.

fixSteps.title: Check for leaks
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off water, unplug, inspect underneath.

fixSteps.title: Dry base pan
fixSteps.instruction: Tilt, dry with towels, verify float drops.

faq.a: Yes but returns if leak not fixed.

fullDescription: The F1 error code indicates the NTC sensor is outside expected range.
whenToCallPro: If sensor tests fine but F1 persists.

title: Main Control Board Error
shortDescription: The main control board has detected an internal fault.
fullDescription: The F8 error code indicates the main control board has an internal fault from power surge, component failure, or defect.

faq.a: If washer is under 5 years and otherwise good, yes.

title: Inverter Board Error
shortDescription: The motor inverter board has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: The FA error code indicates the inverter board that controls the BLDC motor has failed. This is specific to Hitachi models with inverter drive motors.

causes.cause: Loose connector between inverter and main board

symptoms: Motor does not run at all
Motor runs briefly then FA appears

fixSteps.title: Check inverter connections
fixSteps.instruction: Verify all connections between inverter board and motor/main board.

fixSteps.title: Inspect inverter board
fixSteps.instruction: Look for burned components, swollen capacitors.

fixSteps.title: Replace inverter board
fixSteps.instruction: Order correct inverter board. Swap and reconnect.

whenToCallPro: Inverter board diagnosis and replacement is best handled professionally.
videoSearchQuery: Hitachi washer FA error inverter board fix

faq.a: It controls the variable-speed BLDC motor, providing energy-efficient operation.

faq.q: Can a motor fault cause FA?
faq.a: Yes. A shorted motor can overload and damage the inverter board.
